content: (The location is now Honningbrew Meadery.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Daegon, Sabjorn, Serana) (MJR: Maven said you're expecting me.; Mallus Maccius: I'm going to keep this short 'cause we've got a lot to do. Honningbrew's owner, Sabjorn, is about to hold a tasting for Whiterun's captain of the guard and we're going to poison the mead. MJR: You have the poison?; Mallus Maccius: No, no. That's the beauty of the whole plan. We're going to get Sabjorn to give it to us. The meadery has quite a pest problem and the whole city knows about it. Pest poison and mead don't mix well, you know what I mean? MJR: How do I fit in?; Mallus Maccius: You're going to happen by and lend poor old Sabjorn a helping hand. He's going to give you the poison to use on the pests, but you're also going to dump it into the brewing vat. MJR: Clever.; Mallus Maccius: Maven and I spent weeks planning this. All we need is someone like you to get in there and get it done. Now get going before Sabjorn grows a brain and hires someone else to do the dirty work. MJR: How do I get to the brewing vats?; Mallus Maccius: Both of the buildings are connected by tunnels made by the pests infesting the meadery. There's an entrance to it in the basement storeroom of the warehouse that used to be boarded over. I've already removed the boards so the meadery would get infested. That's where you should start. MJR: What about just going in through the brewery?; Mallus Maccius: Sabjorn keeps that locked up tight. If you can get through that way, go right ahead. MJR: Why are you doing all this?; Mallus Maccius: I made the mistake of borrowing coin from Sabjorn. He's allowing me to pay it back, but he's working my fingers to the bone! He treats me like a slave... I have to do every nasty, dirty job in the meadery. MJR: There's more to this than a debt, isn't there?; Mallus Maccius: If this plan works, not only is my debt gone, but I'll be set up for life. Maven and I worked out a little deal. If Sabjorn ends up in jail, she's going to take over his meadery. And guess who gets to run the Black-Briar Meadery in Whiterun? You're looking at him. MJR: Why bother poisoning the nest for Sabjorn?; Mallus Maccius: Once Sabjorn is out of the way, Maven has plans for the place. One way or another, we don't want the pests coming back. Consider it just more of the dirty work. I did my part getting them in there, now you need to clear them out.)
